question: SD 1.5 — How should the auto-destroy mechanic work?

optionA.label: Current (v0.14)
optionA.description: Creations enter with 1 extra Glitch token regardless. If Quality reaches 0 on entry, destroyed immediately. Requires a Quality-boosting Prompt to survive.

optionB.label: Alternative
optionB.description: Creations always survive entry but start with Quality 1 and 2 Glitch tokens. Automatically destroyed at the start of your next turn unless you spend 1 Credit to stabilise them.

question: Aia — CLIP-LOCK Mastery: once per turn or unlimited?

optionA.label: Once Per Turn (v0.14)
optionA.description: Once per turn during your Main Phase, you may apply CLIP-LOCK to one Coherent Creation. Forces strategic timing.

optionB.label: Unlimited (1 Rep each)
optionB.description: You may apply CLIP-LOCK to any number of Coherent Creations during your Main Phase. Each application costs 1 Reputation.
